capabilities: Render latex-vault, tikz, tikzcd and pgfplots code blocks to SVG in Reading and Edit mode
Compile blocks with any locally installed LaTeX package via preamble lines or an extra preamble setting
Auto-detect environments and commands to load matching packages like pgfplots, circuitikz or nicematrix
Cache compiled images on disk with pdflatex/latex plus dvisvgm fallback
Configure TeX engine, binary paths, shell-escape and interface language in settings
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX editor or exporter; it renders fenced LaTeX code blocks in notes to SVG images.
extras: Shell-escape is off by default; the README warns it lets code blocks execute commands and should only be enabled for trusted vaults. Desktop only; a full TeX distribution is recommended to avoid missing-package errors.
intentEvidence: with any installed package, including the ones TikZJax cannot load
problem: Obsidian's built-in math rendering cannot compile TikZ diagrams, pgfplots or arbitrary LaTeX packages inside code blocks.

relations.evidence: Supports any LaTeX package (pgfplots, circuitikz, tikz-cd, forest, nicematrix, algorithmicx, listings, ...), unlike TikZJax.

requires.name: local TeX installation (MiKTeX / TeX Live / MacTeX) with latex/pdflatex and dvisvgm

summary: LaTeX code-block renderer that compiles latex-vault, tikz, tikzcd and pgfplots blocks to SVG using a local TeX installation.
